cues: Our teeth sit in bony sockets, come in two sets, and are of four kinds: incisors cut, canines tear, premolars and molars grind.
The dental formula counts one half of each jaw, so it is doubled.
Two incisors, one canine, two premolars, three molars, above and below: thirty two.
Milk teeth have no premolars: twenty.
